professional_positioning.headline: Registered Nurse & Community Health Coordinator
summary_bullets: 4 years of clinical nursing, ART/MCH service delivery, and patient triage in Lusaka district clinics.
Coordinated community immunization outreach logs and monthly DHIS2 health data submissions.

seniority.evidence_rationale: 4 years hands-on post-registration nursing and clinic reporting experience; suitable for Officer, Coordinator, and Mid-level NGO Health roles.

responsibilities: Managed antenatal care (ANC), outpatient triage, and HIV/ART adherence counselling.
Compiled weekly clinic immunization tallies and submitted monthly DHIS2 service indicators.
verified_outcomes: Maintained zero cold-chain stockout alerts across quarterly vaccine audits (2024-2025).

responsibilities: Assisted maternal ward admissions, patient vitals monitoring, and medical consumables stock tracking.

credential_verification_status.notes: Domestic nursing diploma registered with NMCZ and verified.

inferred_transferable_skills.skill: NGO Health Programme Monitoring & Data Quality
inferred_transferable_skills.inferred_from: Monthly DHIS2 clinic reporting and immunization audit logs
Consumables tracking and vaccine audit record-keeping

adjacent_career_paths.why_plausible: Direct ANC/ART outreach and DHIS2 reporting match donor-funded clinic coordination.
adjacent_career_paths.required_bridge_or_gap: Formal M&E software tools (e.g., PowerBI/KoboToolbox) if required by NGO.

adjacent_career_paths.why_plausible: Accurate patient consent, vitals documentation, and regulatory adherence.
adjacent_career_paths.required_bridge_or_gap: Good Clinical Practice (GCP) certificate often requested.

ambiguities_to_confirm.question: Are you willing to relocate outside Lusaka Province for NGO health programmes?
ambiguities_to_confirm.why_it_matters: Many USAID/NGO public health posts are stationed in Copperbelt, Eastern, or Southern provinces.
ambiguities_to_confirm.candidate_answer: Open to domestic relocation across Zambia.
